**Hint 1:** Consider how the exponential function behaves for large positive values compared to the quadratic function used in L2 regularization. Think about the rate at which each function increases as the coefficient values become larger.

**Hint 2:** Recall that L2 regularization penalizes the square of the coefficients, while exponential regularization involves an exponential function. Compare the growth rates of these functions for large positive coefficients to determine which one imposes a greater penalty.
